execution: Parent-owned local two-AM fixture only. No second application, production, Secrets, manual repairs, or verdict-returning adapters.

browser.open({actor,am,agentId}): Returns authenticated real Playwright {page,origin,switchAM(nextAm),close}; page traffic joins current principal, exact image, request IDs and live non-owner fence for Agent routes. actor user/outsider and named recipient/orgMember/readOnly/publisher/nonpublisher sessions are local fixtures.
browser.otherAM(am): Returns the other existing ingress, never provisions one.
browser.evidence(page): Returns multi-am-browser-evidence-v1 with exact compiled_source/compiled_manifest, actual method/status/request_id/am/serving_am/elapsed_ms and original owner_proof. Retain c275-serving-v1 serving and serving_after snapshots (local forward origin, Pod UID, instance, container, readiness, observation time), started_at/ended_at and attribution verdict/basis. Missing or changed process identity remains unproved. Agent writes prove live distinct non-owner; explicit owner-side GET/HEAD requires peer_read proof with matching method. No headers, request URLs, tokens, bodies, clipboard data or unstructured error text.
browser.responses(page,filter): Optional raw in-memory capture, not a case oracle. Filters pathPrefix/since. Only redacted explicit projections may be observed. Page waitForResponse is the default.
browser.controls: Real Playwright page/popup/download/filechooser/clipboard APIs. UI failures must propagate; no missing-selector skip. Parent owns lease and capture finality.
browser.switchAM(nextAm): Exact read ingress. Cases select the opposite of the observed mutation receipt, then require a later actual GET/HEAD on that AM. Mutations remain routed to observed non-owner.
browser.authentication: Connection, share redemption and account flows require actual browser_session authentication; bearer substitution is insufficient for /auth web routes.

user-fixtures.webSource: Exact compiled UI source SHA from parent artifact selection.
user-fixtures.take(name,ctx): Return unique local run-owned preconditions and cleanup(): {complete,owned_only,...redacted finality}. Register cleanup with ctx.defer before returning custody, including partial setup failure. Setup is via public APIs/approved isolated seed tooling. It MUST NOT perform any step under test or return acceptance verdicts.
sandbox: sandbox-overview: owned active Sandbox, known capacity/limits/environment and child Workspace
sandbox-idle: idle Agent with retained file/history marker and sibling Sandbox
sandbox-runtime-update: busy test turn, two immutable runtime digests, releaseBusy() only completes that test provider response, observed runtime readback and home identity
sandbox-retained: recoverable retained runtime, same-image proof, stale-revision request body and unrelated stale authority fixture
sandbox-activity: real paginated lifecycle records, progress/failure/OOM notice, independently known memory
sandbox-delete: wholly disposable resource and sibling; read-only infrastructure receipt for Pod/volume finality
workspace: workspace-empty and workspace-git: active owned Sandbox with available capacity, approved local Git repository URL/ref and expected commit
workspace-inspect: prepared Git Workspace with Agent/worktrees
workspace-delete: wholly disposable Workspace and unrelated sibling
connections: connection-check/connect/cancel/credential/scope/access-approve/access-deny: local hosted + device-code provider, same/wrong/expired/cancelled account states, required service catalog and original operation IDs
fault controls act on isolated fake upstream only; complete handoff uses actual popup UI; report durable state from real connection APIs; service use effects are counted in provider journal
sharing: share-links: local owner + recipient + orgMember + outsider sessions, no inherited grants, organization and recipient identities
share-grants: isolated organization hierarchy and unrelated control grant
share-interact: deterministic harmless streaming/approval provider with attachment fixture
share-artifacts: approved bytes plus hidden unapproved bytes, enough approved artifacts for pagination, private filesystem artifact file
share-channel: multiple saved actor/binding history pages with no raw credentials
documents: document-format: editable empty document, approved local HTTPS image URL
document-outline: headings/code/Mermaid saved draft and separate effective read-only principal; no public delete means parent disposable-data finality must be explicit
other: browser-control: Agent browser on harmless instrumented local page; input counter/runtime identity read-only journal; one response-loss control, no underlying operation fabrication
terminal-output: deterministic provider requests harmless execute command with marker stdout/stderr and exit; journal binds turn/Agent
trigger-browse: more than one page of owned published/draft Triggers and nonpublisher local account

blocked_policy: Missing fixture or unavailable local upstream is BLOCKED; no row can PASS through declarative receipts, mocked product responses, source assertions, partial UI steps or API status alone. Offline tests verify harness boundaries only.

fixture_methods.readRetained(): Read-only join of actual runtime home identity, sentinel file bytes/hash, and original conversation transcript hash; returns home_id,file_sha256,history_sha256. Compare independently frozen before and after.
fixture_methods.runtimeReadback(): Read-only evidence of actual selected Pod image digest and runtime identity, not a request acknowledgement.
fixture_methods.resourceIds(): Read actual resource ID set; sorted canonical order, excludes no original or replacement resource.
fixture_methods.resourceFinality(): Read-only controller evidence joins exact retired Sandbox/Workspace and intended child finality. Never clean up by manual repair.
fixture_methods.releaseBusy(): Finish ONLY the deterministic fake-provider response that this local fixture held open; no process/Pod mutation.
fixture_methods.failNextRead(name) / dropNextResponse({m: One scoped proxy failure on this case-owned resource, returns close(); afterCommit drops only response after real API effect. Never synthesize API receipts or retry mutations.
fixture_methods.registerWorkspace(id) / registerShare(ag: Add exact acknowledged creation to existing public cleanup custody before any further assertion.
fixture_methods.setProviderState(state): Change only the isolated synthetic upstream authorization state: valid, revoked, unavailable, expired, wrong-account. No production identity configuration.
fixture_methods.blockNextPopup(page): One genuine browser popup denial at the user gesture; restore original browser behavior before explicit recovery.
fixture_methods.restoreOwnerSession(): Complete same local synthetic identity sign-in for expected owner; no token readback in artifacts.
fixture_methods.providerJournal() / effectJournal() / pu: Read independent synthetic upstream/runtime journal entries/counters bound to resource, actor, request/operation ID and time. No precomputed case PASS. Caller asserts effect uniqueness, no unauthorized operations, completed execution, original recovery identity.
fixture_methods.cleanup(): Retire/delete/revoke only run-owned resources through public routes, join children and captures; return complete:true,owned_only:true only at terminal finality. A receipt is additive, never hides original failure.

removed_dependencies: Usage, Trigger authoring/launch and navigation transferred to Developer16; this package owns no cases for those rows.

config.sandbox_profile: Exact approved existing {id,revision}, available to run actor; no profile changes.
config.admin_available: true only when parent actual admin route is installed; required for Always-on setup.

setup_exports.request: Parent authenticated request({actor,am,method,path,body,key}) -> {status,body,timing:{am,request_id}}. Actual transport only, no response fabrication. Separate fixture_request and fixture_creation_custody observations prevent setup being counted as checklist-step coverage.
setup_exports.finality: Read-only independent finality({sandboxId,workspaceId?}); exact IDs plus children_remaining and cleanup_complete. Does not delete anything. Required BEFORE setup creates resources.
setup_exports.readFault: sandbox-overview only: one genuine read transport fault bound to returned own Sandbox, returns close().
setup_exports.cleanup: Registered before first creation; exact resources retired through public routes. Independent child finality required. Any uncertain create stays unresolved for parent; no replay. Every known own Sandbox is attempted even if another cleanup fails.
setup_exports.remaining_scenarios: Require parent low-level provider, runtime, multiaccount, document finality and paginated activity fixtures documented above. No default or pass-through fallback.
